edit_summary.reason: The policy farms repeatable bonuses (controlled_descent_bonus, touchdown_stability_bonus) while staying near the ground off-pad. This revision increases the distance penalty from -0.05 to -0.08 to provide a stronger gradient toward the pad, and conditions the controlled_descent_bonus on being near the pad (distance<0.2) to prevent off-pad farming. The touchdown_stability_bonus is conditioned on being near the pad (distance<0.2) as well. These changes follow the phase_guidance_after_action_coverage mode by adding phase-specific guidance for the approach and touchdown phases without making bonuses one-shot (which failed previously) or tightening conditions too aggressively (which also failed).
preserved_design: velocity_penalty (vertical and lateral) with same scales
fuel_penalty (small -0.01 per main engine use) kept as mild deterrent
controlled_descent_bonus (repeatable, conditioned on distance and angle) but with tighter distance condition
touchdown_stability_bonus (repeatable, conditioned on low velocity and leg contact) but with pad proximity condition
changed_design: Increase progress_shaping distance penalty scale from -0.05 to -0.08 to provide a stronger gradient toward the pad without causing early failure (failed pattern from iter_004 used -0.1 which was too aggressive).

Tighten controlled_descent_bonus distance condition from <0.5 to <0.2 (near pad) so the bonus is only available when the lander is close to the pad. This prevents farming the bonus off-pad while being less restrictive than the failed <0.1 threshold.
Tighten touchdown_stability_bonus to require being near the pad (distance < 0.2) in addition to low velocities and leg contact. This prevents collecting the bonus off-pad.
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not make bonuses one-shot (failed pattern from iter_010->011): bonuses remain repeatable but with tighter conditions.
Do not increase distance penalty too aggressively (failed pattern from iter_004): increase from -0.05 to -0.08, not -0.1.
Do not tighten distance conditions too aggressively (failed pattern from iter_005->006): use <0.2 instead of <0.1.
Do not add improvement bonuses that require internal state tracking (failed pattern from iter_006->007 and iter_010->011): no internal state added.
Do not simply increase raw main-engine/action bonuses: we tighten conditions instead.
edit_summary.action_coverage_plan: All actions already used. The increased distance penalty will encourage the policy to use orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) to steer toward the pad, potentially increasing their usage from ~15% to ~20%. The tighter conditions for bonuses will discourage staying off-pad and encourage approaching the pad.
edit_summary.phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): increased distance penalty (-0.08 * distance) provides a stronger gradient to move toward the pad. Phase 2 (descent): controlled_descent_bonus (repeatable, distance<0.2) rewards using main engine when near pad and upright. Phase 3 (touchdown): touchdown_stability_bonus (repeatable, distance<0.2) rewards low velocity at contact near the pad. Success bonus provides final sparse signal.
edit_summary.payment_mode_plan: controlled_descent_bonus is per-step conditioned on being near the pad (distance<0.2) and upright, so it encourages engine use during descent near the pad but cannot be farmed at a distance. touchdown_stability_bonus is per-step conditioned on being near the pad (distance<0.2) and low velocities, so it encourages stable touchdown on the pad. objective_success_bonus is one-shot event-gated. All other terms are per-step penalties.

edit_summary.reason: The policy farms repeatable bonuses (controlled_descent_bonus, touchdown_stability_bonus) while staying near the ground off-pad. Previous attempts to add distance_improvement_bonus with caps and increase distance penalty failed. This revision: (1) Adds a strong, uncapped distance improvement bonus: +0.5 * (prev_distance - current_distance) when distance decreases. This provides a strong gradient toward the pad that naturally diminishes as the lander approaches, preventing farming. (2) Makes controlled_descent_bonus one-shot event-gated with a larger bonus (+50) and a looser distance condition (distance<1.0) to make it reachable. (3) Keeps distance penalty at -0.08 to avoid making the policy reluctant to move. (4) Removes the repeatable controlled_descent_bonus and touchdown_stability_bonus to prevent farming. The uncapped distance improvement bonus provides a strong, continuous incentive to move toward the pad, and the reachable one-shot bonus provides a clear milestone.
preserved_design: velocity_penalty (vertical and lateral) with same scales
fuel_penalty (small -0.01 per main engine use) kept as mild deterrent
progress_shaping distance penalty scale (-0.08) kept moderate to avoid early termination
changed_design: Add distance_improvement_bonus: +0.5 * (prev_distance - current_distance) when distance decreases, with NO cap. This provides a strong, continuous incentive to move closer to the pad. Use self._prev_distance to track previous distance, reset at episode start via hasattr check.

Make controlled_descent_bonus one-shot event-gated: +50.0 bonus fires once when the lander first enters the near-pad region (distance<1.0) with main engine use (m_power>0) and upright (|angle|<0.2). Track with self._controlled_descent_given flag. The looser distance condition (1.0 vs previous 0.3) makes it reachable.
Remove the repeatable controlled_descent_bonus (was +0.5 per step) to prevent farming.
Keep touchdown_stability_bonus as one-shot +10 (unchanged from current).
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not add distance_improvement_bonus with a cap (failed pattern from iter_009->010, iter_010->011, iter_011->012): now uncapped.
Do not increase distance penalty (failed pattern from iter_009->010, iter_010->011): kept at -0.08.
Do not make one-shot bonuses too small or conditions too tight (failed pattern from iter_009->010, iter_010->011, iter_011->012): now +50 with distance<1.0.
Do not add repeatable positive bonuses that can be farmed: removed controlled_descent_bonus per-step.
Do not call custom self helper methods: use hasattr for internal state.
edit_summary.action_coverage_plan: Action 0 is not necessary for success. The distance improvement bonus will encourage the policy to use orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) to steer toward the pad, potentially increasing their usage from ~25% each to ~30% each. The reachable one-shot controlled_descent_bonus will encourage main engine use (action 2) when near the pad.
edit_summary.phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): distance_improvement_bonus (+0.5 per unit distance decrease, uncapped) provides a strong gradient to move toward the pad. Distance penalty (-0.08 * distance) provides additional mild incentive. Phase 2 (descent): one-shot controlled_descent_bonus (+50) fires when first entering near-pad region (distance<1.0) with main engine use, providing a clear milestone. Phase 3 (touchdown): one-shot touchdown_stability_bonus (+10) fires when both legs contact near the pad with low velocities. Success bonus (+100) provides final sparse signal.
edit_summary.payment_mode_plan: distance_improvement_bonus is per-step but based on improvement (delta), so it naturally diminishes as the lander approaches the pad and cannot be farmed indefinitely. controlled_descent_bonus is one-shot event-gated (fires once). touchdown_stability_bonus is one-shot event-gated (fires once). objective_success_bonus is one-shot event-gated. All other terms are per-step penalties.

edit_summary.reason: The policy farms repeatable bonuses (controlled_descent_bonus, touchdown_stability_bonus) while staying near the ground off-pad. This revision tightens the conditions for these bonuses to require being near the pad (distance < 0.1 for controlled_descent_bonus, distance < 0.15 for touchdown_stability_bonus) so they cannot be collected off-pad. The progress shaping distance penalty is increased from -0.05 to -0.08 to provide a stronger gradient toward the pad without causing early failure. The controlled_descent_bonus remains repeatable but only when the lander is actually near the pad, which should encourage the policy to approach the pad and then use the main engine for controlled descent.
